integrity: The argument derives a uniform-in-residue sign mean from ordinary Möbius cancellation and gives a separate exact squarefree-inclusion-exclusion support count with an O_q(x^(1/4)) remainder. The attached integer-only checker recomputes 400000 terms and exact finite residue counts, without serving as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The modulus is fixed; no uniformity in growing moduli. The signed discrepancy is o_q(x), without an explicit rate. The proof uses the unconditional prime number theorem in fixed arithmetic progressions.
title: Exact three-way residue-class densities for the square-splitting Möbius function
